Originally part of the Boscanova family since 2008, South Coast Coffee was the ambition of a group of proper coffee lovers who wanted to create a space to enjoy delicious locally roasted craft coffee at a safe distance from the chains. We have come a long way since the night we first opened our doors on Richmond Hill but our philosophies and motivations have remained the same; to create banging coffee and delicious hand-made food in a unique space that encourages you to switch off and get lost in a great conversation. South Coast Coffee is as much your home as it is ours and we want you to get comfortable and leave the pressures of modern living at the door. VOTED TOP 50 COFFEE SHOPS IN THE UK FOOD We make all of our food to order, from scratch, every time and the secret to getting this right is to use heaps of fresh produce, which we source locally from a handful of proper good suppliers. Our kitchen might be small but our ambitions are extensive and we are always working on new ways to introduce interesting, delicious food to suit any time of the day.
